strings.name: JB Straubel
strings.summary: A Tesla co-founder, Straubel led battery and powertrain engineering as electric vehicles moved from prototypes to mass production. He founded Redwood Materials in 2017 to recycle batteries, manufacture critical materials and develop storage. He left Tesla’s CTO role in 2019 and joined its board in 2023, linking vehicle engineering with circular battery supply chains.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Tesla and developed Redwood Materials, advancing electric-vehicle battery engineering and the recycling industry.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born 20 December 1975 in Des Moines, Iowa, United States.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: BS in energy systems engineering and MS in engineering, Stanford University.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Electric-vehicle engineering
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led long-term battery, powertrain and production-expansion engineering at Tesla.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Circular battery supply chains
strings.highlights.h2.text: Founded Redwood to connect recycling, refining and battery-material manufacturing.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Expanded storage cooperation
strings.timeline.t1.text: Redwood expanded its energy-storage partnership with Crusoe in March.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Tesla board
strings.timeline.t2.text: Elected an independent director while continuing to lead Redwood.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Materials investment
strings.timeline.t3.text: Redwood announced new financing for circular battery-material supply chains.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Left CTO role
strings.timeline.t4.text: Ended his Tesla CTO tenure, moved to an advisory role and focused on Redwood.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Founded Redwood
strings.timeline.t5.text: Established battery-recycling company Redwood Materials in Nevada.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Tesla technology leadership
strings.timeline.t6.text: Became CTO, responsible for battery and powertrain engineering.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Joined Tesla
strings.timeline.t7.text: Joined as an early employee and was subsequently recognized as a co-founder.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Engineering education
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed undergraduate energy-systems engineering studies at Stanford before a master’s degree.
